items.source: This is particularly useful for delegating to existing data access code that expects a CqlSession to work on and throws DriverException. For newly written code, it is strongly recommended to use CqlTemplate's more specific operations, for example a query or update variant.
items.translation: 这对于委托给现有的数据访问代码非常有用，这些代码期望使用 `CqlSession` 进行操作，并会抛出 `DriverException`。对于新编写的代码，强烈建议使用 `CqlTemplate` 的更具体操作，例如 `query` 或 `update` 变体。

items.source: Allows for returning a result object created within the callback, i.e. a domain object or a collection of domain objects. Note that there's special support for single step actions: see CqlTemplate.queryForObject(String, Class) etc. A thrown RuntimeException is treated as application exception: it gets propagated to the caller of the template.
items.translation: 允许返回在回调中创建的结果对象，即领域对象或领域对象的集合。请注意，单步操作具有特殊支持：参见 CqlTemplate.queryForObject(String, Class) 等方法。抛出的 RuntimeException 被视为应用程序异常：它会被传播到模板的调用者。

items.source: Gets called by CqlTemplate.execute(SessionCallback) with an active Cassandra CqlSession.
items.translation: 由CqlTemplate.execute(SessionCallback)调用，并传入一个活跃的 CassandraCqlSession。

items.source: com.datastax.oss.driver.api.core.DriverException - if thrown by a Session method, to be auto-converted to a DataAccessException.
items.translation: com.datastax.oss.driver.api.core.DriverException - 如果由 Session 方法抛出，则会自动转换为 DataAccessException。

items.source: DataAccessException - in case of custom exceptions.
items.translation: DataAccessException - 针对自定义异常的情况。

items.source: session - active Cassandra Session, must not be null.
items.translation: session - 活动的 Cassandra 会话，不能为 null。

items.source: This is a functional interface and can therefore be used as the assignment target for a lambda expression or method reference.
items.translation: 这是一个函数式接口，因此可用作 Lambda 表达式或方法引用的赋值目标。

items.source: a result object, or null if none.
items.translation: 结果对象，若无则返回 null。

items.source: Generic callback interface for code that operates on a Cassandra CqlSession. Allows to execute any number of operations on a single session, using any type and number of statements.
items.translation: 用于操作 Cassandra CqlSession 的通用回调接口。允许在单个会话上执行任意数量的操作，支持任何类型和数量的语句。

items.source: Gets called by CqlTemplate.execute(SessionCallback) with an active Cassandra CqlSession. Does not need to care about activating or closing the CqlSession.
items.translation: 由CqlTemplate.execute(SessionCallback)调用，并传入一个活跃的 CassandraCqlSession。无需关心激活或关闭该CqlSession。
